meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 它会为每个 PR 建独立的 git worktree,按 ulw-loop 实现并做带证据的手动 QA,写英文 PR,循环跑到 CI 与 Cubic 都通过,默认自动合并后清理 worktree。任务会被拆成最小的原子 PR,独立的分支可并行构建。
howto.when: 当实现工作需要以 PR 形式落地时触发,比如你说“create a PR”、“implement and PR”等,或者只说“实现 X”但语境指向 PR 交付。

say.text: 实现这个 issue,并开一个 PR
say.note: 会拆原子 PR、建 worktree 并跑完整流程

say.text: 把这个任务拆成几个原子 PR,能并行的并行做
say.note: 独立的分片各占一个 worktree 同时构建

say.text: 这个 PR 的 CI 挂了,回 worktree 修一下再重新验证
say.note: 失败关卡会退回实现阶段修复并重新 QA

howto.what_en: For each PR it creates an isolated git worktree, implements via ulw-loop with evidence-bound manual QA, writes a reviewer-readable English PR, loops until CI and Cubic pass, then merges and cleans up. Tasks split into atomic PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR, e.g. “create a PR” or “implement and PR”, or when you just say “implement X” and the context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and open a PR
say_en.note: Splits into atomic PRs, sets up worktrees, runs the full loop

say_en.text: Split this task into atomic PRs and build the independent ones in parallel
say_en.note: Independent slices each get a worktree and build at once

say_en.text: CI failed on this PR — go back to the worktree, fix it, re-verify
say_en.note: Failed gates route back to implementation and fresh QA
